categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: precious metal recycling, precious metal-based new materials, and trade. Precious metal recycling involves recovering platinum, palladium, rhodium, silver, and other valuable metals from waste catalysts and secondary resources. The new materials segment processes recovered precious metals into compounds such as platinum and palladium complexes. The trade segment supports the other two by providing integrated procurement, transportation, and testing services for precious metals and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including ion exchange, solvent extraction, and electric arc furnace smelting for precious metal recovery. It has proprietary technologies for high recovery rates and environmental compliance, with multiple patents and leading domestic R&D capabilities. Production involves selecting appropriate processes for different raw material batches, with automated and intelligent manufacturing systems (DCS, MES, ERP) ensuring quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major petrochemical companies such as China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), Sinopec, and CNOOC, as well as fine chemical, automotive, electronic, and medical industries. The company serves upstream industries generating precious metal secondary resources and downstream industries requiring catalysts and precious metal compounds. It also targets expanding markets like coal chemical, automotive exhaust catalyst recycling, and photovoltaic sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated within China, with headquarters and main facilities in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province. It also has subsidiaries and trade operations in Shanghai, Jiangxi, and Singapore, serving domestic and some international markets. The company’s precious metal trade and new materials business extend to various regions domestically.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the precious metals supply chain. It recycles secondary precious metal resources from waste catalysts (midstream) and processes these into new materials and compounds (downstream). It also provides trade and logistics services, integrating upstream raw material procurement and downstream product sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding market share in petrochemical catalyst recycling, developing new precious metal compound products, and entering new markets such as automotive exhaust catalyst recycling. The company emphasizes technological innovation to improve recovery efficiency and environmental compliance, with ongoing R&D projects on ruthenium, iridium recovery, and advanced processing techniques. It invests heavily in automation, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing systems to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of recovered precious metals and new material products, as well as service fees from entrusted processing contracts. The company also earns income from trading precious metals and related products. Pricing is based on market prices of precious metals, adjusted for recovery rates and processing costs. The company uses a combination of upfront purchase and entrusted processing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in precious metal recycling with a strong brand and established relationships with major petrochemical enterprises. It competes with other domestic precious metal recyclers and faces increasing competition from global precious metal companies entering the Chinese market. Its technological edge, comprehensive service offerings, and compliance with environmental regulations position it favorably in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.66 billion, a 5.2% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 116.6 million, up 11.4%. Total assets reached RMB 3.04 billion, growing 60.7% from the previous year. The company has shown steady revenue growth driven by trade business expansion and maintains positive cash flow from operations after prior years of negative cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high recovery rates of precious metals from complex secondary resources using proprietary, environmentally compliant technologies. It provides integrated services from raw material procurement to new material production and trade, enhancing customer convenience and loyalty. Its products, including high-purity precious metal compounds, meet diverse industry needs, supported by strong R&D and quality control systems. The company’s brand reputation and compliance with stringent environmental standards differentiate it in a competitive market.
